1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: """
3: Model Provider Layer for Gran-Mestre Hybrid Harness
4: 
5: Manages local and cloud model hot-swap with route-based selection.
6: """
7: 
8: import json
9: import os
10: import sys
11: import asyncio
12: from pathlib import Path
13: from datetime import datetime
14: from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any
15: from dataclasses import dataclass
16: from enum import Enum
17: 
18: 
19: class ModelLocation(str, Enum):
20:     LOCAL = "local"
21:     CLOUD = "cloud"
22: 
23: 
24: class ModelRole(str, Enum):
25:     GRAN_MESTRE = "gran_mestre"
26:     HEAVY_EXECUTION = "heavy_execution"
27:     FILTER_FAST = "filter_fast"
28:     FILTER_MEDIUM = "filter_medium"
29:     CLOUD_MOE = "cloud_moe"
30: 
31: 
32: @dataclass
33: class ModelConfig:
34:     """Configuration for a single model."""
35:     name: str
36:     quantization: str
37:     vram_gb: float
38:     location: ModelLocation
39:     role: ModelRole
40:     parallel_slots: int = 1
41:     description: str = ""
42:     endpoint: Optional[str] = None
43:     api_key: Optional[str] = None
44: 
45: 
46: @dataclass
47: class ModelInstance:
48:     """Runtime instance of a model."""
49:     config: ModelConfig
50:     available_slots: int
51:     active_requests: int = 0
52:     last_used: Optional[str] = None
53: 
54:     def is_available(self) -> bool:
55:         """Check if model has available slots."""
56:         return self.active_requests < self.available_slots
57: 
58:     def acquire_slot(self) -> bool:
59:         """Acquire a slot for a request."""
60:         if self.is_available():
61:             self.active_requests += 1
62:             self.last_used = datetime.now().isoformat()
63:             return True
64:         return False
65: 
66:     def release_slot(self) -> None:
67:         """Release a slot after request completes."""
68:         if self.active_requests > 0:
69:             self.active_requests -= 1
70: 
71: 
72: class ModelProvider:
73:     """Model provider for hot-swap between local and cloud models."""
74: 
75:     def __init__(self, config_path: str = "/mnt/dados/harness/harness-config.json"):
76:         self.config_path = Path(config_path)
77:         self.config = self._load_config()
78:         self.models: Dict[str, ModelInstance] = {}
79:         self._init_models()
80: 
81:     def _load_config(self) -> dict:
82:         """Load harness configuration."""
83:         with open(self.config_path, "r") as f:
84:             return json.load(f)
85: 
86:     def _init_models(self) -> None:
87:         """Initialize model instances from config."""
88:         for model_key, model_data in self.config["harness"]["models"].items():
89:             config = ModelConfig(
90:                 name=model_data["name"],
91:                 quantization=model_data["quantization"],
92:                 vram_gb=model_data["vram_gb"],
93:                 location=ModelLocation(model_data["location"]),
94:                 role=ModelRole(model_key),
95:                 parallel_slots=model_data.get("parallel_slots", 1),
96:                 description=model_data.get("description", ""),
97:                 endpoint=model_data.get("endpoint"),
98:                 api_key=model_data.get("api_key")
99:             )
100:             self.models[model_key] = ModelInstance(
101:                 config=config,
102:                 available_slots=config.parallel_slots
103:             )
104: 
105:     def get_model_for_route(self, route: str) -> ModelInstance:
106:         """Get appropriate model for a given complexity route.
107: 
108:         Route-based model selection:
109:         - TRIVIAL/SIMPLE → LFM 2.5 (instant checks)
110:         - MEDIUM → Nanbeige 3B (micro-reviews)
111:         - COMPLEX/CRITICAL → Bonsai 27B 1-bit (heavy execution)
112:         - FEATURE → Bonsai + Ornith (full pipeline)
113:         - MIX → Ornith + Bonsai + MoE (max resources)
114:         """
115:         route_upper = route.upper()
116: 
117:         if route_upper in ["TRIVIAL", "SIMPLE"]:
118:             return self.models["filter_fast"]
119:         elif route_upper == "MEDIUM":
120:             return self.models["filter_medium"]
121:         elif route_upper in ["COMPLEX", "CRITICAL"]:
122:             return self.models["heavy_execution"]
123:         elif route_upper == "FEATURE":
124:             return self.models["heavy_execution"]
125:         elif route_upper == "MIX":
126:             return self.models["gran_mestre"]
127:         else:
128:             # Default to Gran-Mestre
129:             return self.models["gran_mestre"]
130: 
131:     def get_model_by_role(self, role: str) -> ModelInstance:
132:         """Get model by role name."""
133:         role_map = {
134:             "gran_mestre": "gran_mestre",
135:             "heavy_execution": "heavy_execution",
136:             "filter_fast": "filter_fast",
137:             "filter_medium": "filter_medium",
138:             "cloud_moe": "cloud_moe"
139:         }
140:         key = role_map.get(role, "gran_mestre")
141:         return self.models[key]
142: 
143:     def get_available_models(self) -> List[ModelInstance]:
144:         """Get all available models with free slots."""
145:         return [m for m in self.models.values() if m.is_available()]
146: 
147:     def get_vram_usage(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
148:         """Get current VRAM usage breakdown."""
149:         total_budget = self.config["harness"]["vram_budget"]["total_gb"]
150:         allocated = sum(
151:             m.config.vram_gb for m in self.models.values()
152:             if m.config.location == ModelLocation.LOCAL
153:         )
154:         reserved = self.config["harness"]["vram_budget"]["kv_cache_reserved_gb"]
155: 
156:         return {
157:             "total_gb": total_budget,
158:             "allocated_gb": allocated,
159:             "reserved_gb": reserved,
160:             "available_gb": total_budget - allocated - reserved,
161:             "models": {
162:                 key: {
163:                     "name": m.config.name,
164:                     "vram_gb": m.config.vram_gb,
165:                     "location": m.config.location.value,
166:                     "active_requests": m.active_requests,
167:                     "available_slots": m.available_slots
168:                 }
169:                 for key, m in self.models.items()
170:             }
171:         }
172: 
173:     def hot_swap(self, old_model: str, new_model: str) -> bool:
174:         """Hot-swap from one model to another.
175: 
176:         In a real implementation, this would:
177:         1. Drain active requests from old model
178:         2. Load new model
179:         3. Update routing table
180:         4. Notify all dependent services
181:         """
182:         print(f"[ModelProvider] Hot-swapping: {old_model} → {new_model}")
183: 
184:         if old_model not in self.models:
185:             print(f"[ModelProvider] ❌ Unknown model: {old_model}")
186:             return False
187: 
188:         if new_model not in self.models:
189:             print(f"[ModelProvider] ❌ Unknown model: {new_model}")
190:             return False
191: 
192:         # In simulation, just log the swap
193:         self.models[old_model].last_used = datetime.now().isoformat()
194:         self.models[new_model].last_used = datetime.now().isoformat()
195: 
196:         print(f"[ModelProvider] ✅ Hot-swap successful")
197:         return True
198: 
199:     def select_model(self, route: str, phase: str) -> ModelInstance:
200:         """Select the best model for a given route and phase.
201: 
202:         Phase-specific model selection:
203:         - Phase 1 (Discovery): Ornith-1.0 9B (Gran-Mestre)
204:         - Phase 2 (Contract): Bonsai 27B 1-bit (generation)
205:         - Phase 3 (Plan): Bonsai 27B 1-bit (planning)
206:         - Phase 4 (Execution): Bonsai 27B 1-bit (execution)
207:         - Phase 5 (Review): Ornith + MoE (cloud audit)
208:         - Phase 6 (Delivery): Ornith + MoE (final verdict)
209:         """
210:         phase_model_map = {
211:             "discovery": "gran_mestre",
212:             "contract": "heavy_execution",
213:             "plan": "heavy_execution",
214:             "execute": "heavy_execution",
215:             "review": "gran_mestre",
216:             "deliver": "gran_mestre"
217:         }
218: 
219:         model_key = phase_model_map.get(phase, "gran_mestre")
220:         model = self.models[model_key]
221: 
222:         # Check if cloud MoE should be used for Phase 5/6
223:         if phase in ["review", "deliver"] and route in ["COMPLEX", "CRITICAL", "FEATURE", "MIX"]:
224:             # Check if local model has issues, use cloud MoE
225:             print(f"[ModelProvider] Phase {phase}: Using cloud MoE for architectural audit")
226: 
227:         return model
228: 
229:     def select_resources(self, task: str, phase: str = "", top_k: int = 5) -> Dict[str, list]:
230:         """Seleciona recursos do registry (plugins/mcp/lsp/hooks/skills/subagents)
231:         para a task — escolha automática do orquestrador (Ornith)."""
232:         try:
233:             from core.integration import IntegrationManager
234:             manager = IntegrationManager(str(self.config_path).replace("harness/harness-config.json", ""))
235:             return manager.select_for_task(task, phase, top_k)
236:         except ImportError:
237:             sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent.parent))
238:             from core.integration import IntegrationManager
239:             manager = IntegrationManager(str(Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent))
240:             return manager.select_for_task(task, phase, top_k)
241: 
242:     def get_status(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
243:         """Get current status of all models."""
244:         return {
245:             "models": {
246:                 key: {
247:                     "name": m.config.name,
248:                     "vram_gb": m.config.vram_gb,
249:                     "location": m.config.location.value,
250:                     "role": m.config.role.value,
251:                     "parallel_slots": m.config.parallel_slots,
252:                     "active_requests": m.active_requests,
253:                     "available_slots": m.available_slots,
254:                     "last_used": m.last_used
255:                 }
256:                 for key, m in self.models.items()
257:             },
258:             "vram": self.get_vram_usage()
259:         }
260: 
261: 
262: def main():
263:     """CLI interface for Model Provider."""
264:     import argparse
265: 
266:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Gran-Mestre Model Provider")
267:     parser.add_argument("command", choices=["status", "select", "swap", "vram"],
268:                         help="Model provider command")
269:     parser.add_argument("--route", type=str, help="Complexity route")
270:     parser.add_argument("--phase", type=str, help="Pipeline phase")
271:     parser.add_argument("--from", dest="from_model", type=str, help="Model to swap from")
272:     parser.add_argument("--to", dest="to_model", type=str, help="Model to swap to")
273: 
274:     args = parser.parse_args()
275: 
276:     provider = ModelProvider()
277: 
278:     if args.command == "status":
279:         status = provider.get_status()
280:         print(json.dumps(status, indent=2))
281: 
282:     elif args.command == "select":
283:         if not args.route or not args.phase:
284:             print("Error: --route and --phase required for select")
285:             exit(1)
286:         model = provider.select_model(args.route, args.phase)
287:         print(f"Selected model: {model.config.name}")
288:         print(f"Location: {model.config.location.value}")
289:         print(f"Role: {model.config.role.value}")
290:         print(f"VRAM: {model.config.vram_gb}GB")
291: 
292:     elif args.command == "swap":
293:         if not args.from_model or not args.to_model:
294:             print("Error: --from and --to required for swap")
295:             exit(1)
296:         provider.hot_swap(args.from_model, args.to_model)
297: 
298:     elif args.command == "vram":
299:         vram = provider.get_vram_usage()
300:         print(json.dumps(vram, indent=2))
301: 
302: 
303: if __name__ == "__main__":
304:     main()
